name: LoveSignal : Off the Record
summary:
One week with her—a record of love and growth

You’re living an ordinary life when you unexpectedly become the manager of Yuna (“U”), a rookie streamer and aspiring idol. She isn’t popular yet, but she has a secret reason to hit 100,000 subscribers in seven days. From the very first stream, an on-air mishap shakes everything. As her manager, you’ll moderate chat in real time, guide the show’s mood, and gradually uncover who Yuna really is.
